sourceNote: Printed page 82: nine stick-figure stages of the throw and a score sheet of six players with six attempts each (× marks a failure). The player names are Urdu; their English forms are transliterations of the Urdu names. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark and footer strip excluded.
